svg.title: Romania study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Dealu Mare near Urlați; 2: Cotnari; 3: Târnave near Jidvei; 4: Drăgășani; 5: Murfatlar; 6: Recaș; 7: Bucharest; 8: Iași; 9: Cluj-Napoca; 10: Brașov; 11: Craiova; 12: Bacău

g.title: 1 · Dealu Mare near Urlați: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
